name: Комбінація (6)
description: In advanced combinations, you can sometimes combine multiple tactical themes into a single sequence of moves. This is done by combining basic tactics such as pins and double attacks, or by temporarily sacrificing material to recover it with interest.

examples.text: With a brilliant sacrifice, White wins material. After the capture, both the black queen and black bishop are under attack, leaving Black with no choice.
This time, White takes advantage of the pin on the c6-pawn to create a fork.
